content.json:
## Provenex Overview

SOC view over Provenex provenance receipts (schema 2.6.0+). Top row: operating posture and the TAMPERED alarm. Middle: policy-decision activity. Bottom: drift detector and the advisory-rollout signal.

content.query:
Provenex_Receipt_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend mode = coalesce(tostring(parse_json(policy_s).mode), "pre-1.0.0")
| summarize count() by mode
| sort by count_ desc
content.title: Operating mode (24h)

content.query:
Provenex_Receipt_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| extend summary = parse_json(summary_s)
| where toint(summary.tampered) > 0
| summarize count_tampered = count() by host_s
| sort by count_tampered desc
content.title: TAMPERED alarms (1h)

content.query:
Provenex_Receipt_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend tcc = parse_json(policy_s).tool_call_control
| extend decisions = parse_json(tostring(tcc.decisions))
| mv-expand decision = decisions
| where decision.decision == "deny"
| summarize denies = count() by caller_hash_s
| sort by denies desc
| take 20
content.title: Denied tool calls by caller

content.query:
Provenex_Receipt_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend ac = parse_json(policy_s).access_control
| extend decisions = parse_json(tostring(ac.decisions))
| mv-expand decision = decisions
| extend jurisdiction = tostring(decision.inputs.request_context.jurisdiction)
| extend sources = parse_json(sources_s)
| mv-expand source = sources
| where source.verification_outcome == "UNVERIFIED"
| summarize unverified = count() by jurisdiction
| sort by unverified desc
content.title: UNVERIFIED chunks by jurisdiction

content.query:
Provenex_Receipt_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend mode = tostring(parse_json(policy_s).mode)
| where mode == "advisory"
| extend summary = parse_json(summary_s)
| where tostring(summary.overall_status) == "FAIL"
| extend ac = parse_json(policy_s).access_control
| extend policy_id = tostring(ac.policy_id)
| summarize would_have_blocked = count() by policy_id, caller_hash_s
| sort by would_have_blocked desc
content.title: Advisory-mode would-have-blocked

content.query:
Provenex_Drift_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| extend distinct_count = array_length(parse_json(distinct_fingerprints_s))
| summarize total = sum(distinct_count), events = count() by host_s
| sort by total desc
content.title: Drift detector alerts (7d)
